affected: Android API < 17 (apps with targetSdk < 17 stay exposed on later OS builds)
patch_ref: Android 4.2 (API 17): only @JavascriptInterface methods exposed to apps targeting 17+
public_writeup: Metasploit: Android Browser and WebView addJavascriptInterface Code Execution
chain_stage: U->E: URL->WebView page JS->bridge object->Java Reflection->Runtime.exec (shell)
nvd_description: The Android API before 17 does not properly restrict the WebView.addJavascriptInterface method, which allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary methods of Java objects by using the Java Reflection API within crafted JavaScript code that is loaded into the WebView component in an application targeted to API level 16 or earlier, a related issue to CVE-2013-4710.

affected: Android before 4.4 (SearchBox object exposed via BrowserFrame.java)
chain_stage: U->E: URL->WebView->exposed SearchBox bridge object->code execution
nvd_description: java/android/webkit/BrowserFrame.java in Android before 4.4 uses the addJavascriptInterface API in conjunction with creating an object of the SearchBoxImpl class, which allows attackers to execute arbitrary Java code by leveraging access to the searchBoxJavaBridge_ interface at certain Android API levels.

affected: Android prior to 4.4.0 (accessibility / accessibilityTraversal objects)
chain_stage: U->E: URL->WebView->accessibility bridge objects->code execution
nvd_description: A Code Execution vulnerability exists in Android prior to 4.4.0 related to the addJavascriptInterface method and the accessibility and accessibilityTraversal objects, which could let a remote malicious user execute arbitrary code.

affected: Android WebView before 4.4
chain_stage: U->E: URL->WebView->NUL-char SOP bypass->local-file theft (pivot stage)
nvd_description: The Android WebView in Android before 4.4 allows remote attackers to bypass the Same Origin Policy via a crafted attribute containing a \u0000 character, as demonstrated by an onclick="window.open('\u0000javascript: sequence to the Android Browser application 4.2.1 or a third-party web browser.

affected: Apple iOS before 9.3.3; Safari before 9.1.2; tvOS before 9.2.2
public_writeup: ZDI-16-485: Apple Safari Array.slice OOB access
chain_stage: U->E: URL->Safari renderer->memory corruption->RCE (shell)
nvd_description: WebKit in Apple iOS before 9.3.3, Safari before 9.1.2, and tvOS before 9.2.2 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via a crafted web site, a different vulnerability than CVE-2016-4589, CVE-2016-4623, and CVE-2016-4624.

affected: Google Chrome before 70.0.3538.64 (V8)
public_writeup: Chrome Releases: Stable Channel Update for Desktop (Oct 2018)
chain_stage: U->E: URL->Chrome renderer->V8 type confusion->RCE (shell)
nvd_description: Incorrect side effect annotation in V8 in Google Chrome prior to 70.0.3538.64 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside a sandbox via a crafted HTML page.

affected: Google Chrome before 72.0.3626.81 (V8)
chain_stage: U->E: URL->Chrome renderer->V8 optimization bug->RCE (shell)
nvd_description: Incorrect optimization assumptions in V8 in Google Chrome prior to 72.0.3626.81 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside a sandbox via a crafted HTML page.

affected: Google Chrome before 80.0.3987.122 (V8; exploited in the wild)
public_writeup: Chrome Releases: Stable Channel Update for Desktop (Feb 2020, in-the-wild ack)
chain_stage: U->E: URL->Chrome renderer->V8 type confusion->RCE (shell)
nvd_description: Type confusion in V8 in Google Chrome prior to 80.0.3987.122 allowed a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page.

affected: Apache Cordova Android before 3.5.1 (and apps built on it)
chain_stage: U->E: URL with crafted URI scheme->Cordova WebView bridge->launch arbitrary apps
nvd_description: Apache Cordova Android before 3.5.1 allows remote attackers to open and send data to arbitrary applications via a URL with a crafted URI scheme for an Android intent.

affected: Lenovo SHAREit before 3.5.98_ww on Android < 4.2
chain_stage: U->E: crafted intent: URL->scheme handler->unspecified impact in handler app
nvd_description: Lenovo SHAREit before 3.5.98_ww on Android before 4.2 allows remote attackers to have unspecified impact via a crafted intent: URL, aka an "intent scheme URL attack."

affected: Google Chrome before 60.0.3112.78 for Android
chain_stage: U->E: page navigation between schemes->insufficient policy enforcement->policy bypass
nvd_description: Insufficient policy enforcement during navigation between different schemes in Google Chrome prior to 60.0.3112.78 for Android allowed a remote attacker to perform cross origin content download via a crafted HTML page, related to intents.

affected: Dolphin Browser for Android 12.0.2
chain_stage: U->E: URL->insecure Intent URI parsing->native component launch
nvd_description: The Dolphin Browser for Android 12.0.2 suffers from an insecure parsing implementation of the Intent URI scheme. This vulnerability could allow attackers to abuse this implementation through a malicious Intent URI, in order to invoke private Activities within the Dolphin Browser.

affected: Android before 5.1.1 LMY48I (libstagefright)
public_writeup: jduck/cve-2015-1538-1: public stsc MP4 atom exploit
chain_stage: U->E: URL->page embeds crafted MP4->libstagefright integer overflow->RCE (shell)
nvd_description: Integer overflow in the SampleTable::setSampleToChunkParams function in SampleTable.cpp in libstagefright in Android before 5.1.1 LMY48I allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted atoms in MP4 data that trigger an unchecked multiplication, aka internal bug 20139950, a related issue to CVE-2015-4496.

affected: Android 1.6 Donut through 4.2 Jelly Bean (APK signature verification)
public_writeup: ZDNET: Google releases fix to OEMs for Bluebox 'Master Key' Android security hole
chain_stage: U->download/consent: URL->trojaned APK accepted as same-signature update->install->code on device
nvd_description: Android 1.6 Donut through 4.2 Jelly Bean does not properly check cryptographic signatures for applications, which allows attackers to execute arbitrary code via an application package file (APK) that is modified in a way that does not violate the cryptographic signature, probably involving multiple entries in a Zip file with the same name in which one entry is validated but the other entry is installed, aka Android security bug 8219321 and the "Master Key" vulnerability.

affected: Android 5.1.1 through 8.0 (ART / v1 APK signature scheme)
chain_stage: U->download/consent: URL->DEX-prepended APK passes v1 signature->install as update->code on device
nvd_description: An elevation of privilege vulnerability in the Android system (art). Product: Android. Versions: 5.1.1, 6.0, 6.0.1, 7.0, 7.1.1, 7.1.2, 8.0. Android ID A-64211847.

affected: FreeType before 2.4.2, as used in Apple iOS before 4.0.2 (MobileSafari)
patch_ref: iOS 4.0.2 (FreeType 2.4.2); publicized via the jailbreakme.com page-JS exploit
chain_stage: U->E: URL->MobileSafari renders crafted PDF/font (CFF Type2 CharStrings)->stack overflow->RCE (shell)
nvd_description: Multiple stack-based buffer overflows in the cff_decoder_parse_charstrings function in the CFF Type2 CharStrings interpreter in cff/cffgload.c in FreeType before 2.4.2, as used in Apple iOS before 4.0.2 on the iPhone and iPod touch and before 3.2.2 on the iPad, allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via crafted CFF opcodes in embedded fonts in a PDF document, as demonstrated by JailbreakMe. NOTE: some of these details are obtained from third party information.

chain_stage: U->E: URL->Safari/WebKit->JavaScript-array race->arbitrary code execution
nvd_description: Race condition in WebKit in Apple iOS before 6.0.1 and Safari before 6.0.2 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial of service (application crash) via vectors involving JavaScript arrays.

chain_stage: U->E: URL->Safari/WebKit->memory corruption->code execution
nvd_description: An issue was discovered in certain Apple products. iOS before 11.4 is affected. chain_stage: U->E: URL->Safari/WebKit->universal cross-site scripting->same-origin break (session hijack / payload pivot)
nvd_description: This issue was addressed by improved management of object lifetimes. This issue is fixed in iOS 12.5.2, iOS 14.4.2 and iPadOS 14.4.2, watchOS 7.3.3. Processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to universal cross site scripting. Apple is aware of a report that this issue may have been actively exploited..

affected: Apache Cordova 3.3.0 and earlier; Adobe PhoneGap 2.9.0 and earlier (all platforms incl. iOS)
chain_stage: U->E: URL->hybrid-app bridge->non-anchored whitelist regex bypass->bridge API reachable from attacker origin
nvd_description: Apache Cordova 3.3.0 and earlier and Adobe PhoneGap 2.9.0 and earlier do not anchor the end of domain-name regular expressions, which allows remote attackers to bypass a whitelist protection mechanism via a domain name that contains an acceptable name as an initial substring.

affected: Apache Cordova iOS before 4.0.0
chain_stage: U->E: URL->WKWebView hybrid app->URL-whitelist bypass->arbitrary resource load (bridge pivot)
nvd_description: Apache Cordova iOS before 4.0.0 might allow attackers to bypass a URL whitelist protection mechanism in an app and load arbitrary resources by leveraging unspecified methods.

affected: Apache Cordova iOS before 4.0.0
chain_stage: U->E: crafted link->Cordova iOS bridge->arbitrary plugin execution (app-process code)
nvd_description: Apache Cordova iOS before 4.0.0 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary plugins via a link.
